mcq_fix.s: Which provision made a judicial inquiry mandatory in cases of custodial death, and what is its present BNSS equivalent?

patterns: PYQs here are few: prisons as a State subject governed by the Prisons Act 1894 (UPSC 2023 statement I/II) and parole rules being State-specific (UPSC 2021).
Other PSCs ask a single current-affairs fact: Amnesty names China as the biggest executioner.
Likely APPSC shapes: case-to-principle matches (D.K. Basu, Bachan Singh 'rarest of rare'), Article 72 vs 161 pardon powers, Seventh Schedule entry.
App MCQs are dense multi-statement items on directives and NCRB 2024 data, more detailed than any PYQ shows.
